user.description: Address and web UI password of a TP-Link G.hn powerline adapter. Each adapter is added on its own.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the adapter, e.g. 192.168.0.100
data_description.password: The password of the adapter's web page (not your TP-Link ID)

reauth_confirm.description: The adapter at {host} no longer accepts the password. Enter the current one. Several wrong passwords in a row lock its web UI for a while.

reconfigure.description: Change the address or the password of this adapter.

error.invalid_auth: The adapter rejected the password. Several wrong passwords in a row lock its web UI for a while.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a supported TP-Link powerline adapter at this address.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from the adapter. Enable debug logging and open an issue.
error.busy: Someone is logged in to the adapter's web page: log out there, then try again.
error.locked: The adapter's web page is locked after too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

abort.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different adapter.

command_failed.message: The adapter did not accept the command: {error}

auth_failed.message: The adapter rejected the password: enter the current one in the re-authentication request.
